# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_static_route (Resource)

Use the `ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_static_route` resource to manage a static route attached to a cloud router VRF.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the static route
- `network_service_configs` (List of String) List of network service config IDs this static route is attached to
- `next_hop` (String) Next hop IPv4 address or 'aggregate'
- `prefix` (String) IPv4 prefix in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.0.0/24)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vrf` (String) VRF ID (derived from network service configs)
